definitions.gloss: to adjust, to regulate, to fine-tune
definitions.explanation: To make small changes to something so that it works properly or reaches the desired state.
To organize and harmonize different elements, especially schedules or opinions among people.

examples.japanese: ⟦{音量|おんりょう}→音量：10009_onryou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{調整|ちょうせい}する。
⟦{温度|おんど}→温度：00333_ondo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調整|ちょうせい}→調整：14839_chousei⟧して⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調整|ちょうせい}→調整：14839_chousei⟧して、⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決|き}めた→決める：00858_kimeru⟧。
examples.english: We coordinated our schedules and decided on the meeting date.

notes:
{調整|ちょうせい}する is composed of {調|ちょう} (tune, investigate) + {整|せい} (arrange, put in order).
